# Three.js browser dependencies

These files are copied unchanged from the `three` npm package, version 0.125.2.
Only the browser module, OrbitControls and OBJExporter are included.
Their relative directory layout preserves the examples' imports.

Three.js is MIT licensed; its original notice is preserved in LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r125

The checked-in files let GitHub Pages serve the viewer directly from main's
root without npm, a build workflow, or a third-party JavaScript CDN.
